text: Again, ew. You know, I'd love to hear more about how your day went. Could we get a cup of coffee sometime? Well, it doesn't have to be coffee. How about dinner? Great. I know a terrific little Italian place.

text: I don't drink coffee. I do. I love me a cup of joe. I do eat dinner.

text: I never eat in strange restaurants. One runs the risk of non-standard cutlery.

text: Sheldon lives in fear of the three times fork. Three times is not a fork. Three times is a trident. Forks are for eating. Tridents are for ruling the seven seas.
